## Who this is for

This site is for analysts, researchers, and data stewards who need a practical linkage workflow in R: clear preprocessing, transparent matching rules, and reporting that is good enough for audit, reproducibility, and epidemiologic interpretation.

::: {.callout-note .reporting}
## How to cite

Use the repository citation metadata in `CITATION.cff`. Until final author details are confirmed, the placeholder ORCID is `0000-0000-0000-0000`.
:::
